rule_or_requirement: Local candidates must finish the qualified line on at least as many matched cells as the selected control before a faster lap can justify advancement.
observable_information: At inference, four grayscale frames and pixel-only road, speed, and obstacle diagnostics; evaluator records finish, action, speed, road contact, and runtime.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Use the previously frozen launch-only ZIP without the preview steering wrapper; no source or action threshold changes.
expected_success_endpoint: Determine whether the launch-only ZIP itself finishes consumed track 3 seed 7040, isolating preview contribution to the candidate-only late off-track failure.
falsifier: Package mismatch or invalid execution; if launch-only also fails 3:7040, preview is not necessary for that failure.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Run exact launch-only and selected ZIPs on already consumed tracks 1-3 seeds 7040-7043; inspect track 3 seed 7040 trace rather than treating the 12 cells as fresh evidence.
resource_and_risk_gate: Registered local diagnostic only, 2 CPUs, 2 GiB, 1800 seconds; no fresh performance promotion or external action.
